collection.description: Following a rare, severe accident, a surviving villager is recovering from limb loss and adjusting to a changed body.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Following a rare, severe accident, (villager), a surviving villager, is recovering from limb loss and adjusting to a changed body.

choices.label: Ask How the Villager Wants to Participate

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: Recovery is uneven, and (villager) needs sustained assistance rather than a quick cure.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: They choose a meaningful role that fits their present abilities.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: They ask to postpone responsibilities until they feel ready.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (villager) describes their loss without being interrupted by cheerful advice.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (friend), a trusted friend, simply sits beside them on a difficult afternoon.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: Neighbors improve access to familiar gathering places.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: A proposed aid proves awkward, so (villager) helps redesign it.

a1__fx.name: Outcome A1
a1__fx.text: (healer) and the community focus on wound care, comfort, and gradual recovery.
